faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and services
faq.question1: How do I track my order?
faq.answer1: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can use this number to track your order on our website or the carrier's website.
faq.answer2: We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. Returns are free within this period.
faq.answer3: Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business days delivery.
faq.answer4: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping times vary by location but typically take 7-14 business days.
faq.question5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer5: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and cash on delivery for select locations.
faq.question6: How can I contact customer support?
faq.answer6: You can reach our customer support team via email, phone, or the contact form on our website. We're available 24/7 to assist you.
faq.lingerieAnswer: For hygiene and safety reasons, lingerie items are not eligible for return or exchange. If the item is defective, please contact us within 7 days with a clear photo and we'll assist with an exchange or refund after review.
faq.contactMessage: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please chat to our friendly team.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our shipping and return policies
shipping.deliveryTimeDesc: Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping is available for faster delivery within 1-2 business days.
shipping.shippingCostDesc: Free shipping on orders over $50. Standard shipping costs $5.99 for orders under $50.
shipping.trackingDesc: Track your order anytime using the tracking number sent to your email after shipment.
shipping.returnWindowDesc: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to return your items for a full refund.
shipping.returnConditionsDesc: Items must be unused, in original packaging, and with all tags attached.
shipping.refundProcessDesc: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned items.
shipping.packagingDesc: All orders are carefully packaged to ensure your items arrive in perfect condition.
shipping.processingTimeDesc: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days before shipment.
shipping.needHelpDesc: Our customer service team is here to help with any questions about shipping or returns.
shipping.lingerieExceptionDesc: To protect health and safety, all lingerie items are non-returnable and non-exchangeable. If you receive a product with a manufacturing defect, contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the defect and our support team will review the case.
